themes.description: Users are experiencing frustrating issues with customer support, including poor responsiveness, long wait times, and unhelpful support agents.
themes.business_impact: Delayed responses to critical issues, such as account access problems or trade execution errors, can lead to significant financial losses and reputational damage.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Insufficient training or resources for support agents, outdated support infrastructure, or inadequate escalation procedures may be contributing to the poor support experience.
themes.action_plan:
• Provide comprehensive training for support agents
• Update the support infrastructure to improve response times and quality
• Establish clear escalation procedures to address critical issues.

themes.description: Users are facing issues with chart loading, including charts not opening, taking a long time to load, showing a blank screen, failing to update in real-time, and not displaying reliable data. This is observed in both mobile and Android applications, with some users experiencing this issue since the new update.
themes.business_impact: Delayed or failed chart loading can lead to missed trading opportunities, increased frustration with the application, and potential losses due to delayed or incorrect data.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The possible root cause of this issue could be a problem with data synchronization, network connectivity issues, or potential bugs within the charting engine. However, detailed investigation and debugging would be required to confirm the root cause.
themes.action_plan:
• Investigate data synchronization and network connectivity issues,
• Conduct a thorough debugging of the charting engine,
• Collaborate with the UX design team to enhance user feedback and error messaging,
• Enhance app stability and performance,
• Conduct A/B testing to identify potential UI and UX optimizations.

themes.description: Users are requesting various features to enhance user experience and improve functionality of the platform. The main concern is that the platform lacks some essential features compared to its competitors.
themes.business_impact: Loss of competitive advantage, potential loss of users to competitors that offer more features, and decreased user satisfaction.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The platform's feature set is not as comprehensive as its competitors, leading to user dissatisfaction and requests for new features.
themes.action_plan: • Review the feature set of competitors and identify areas for improvement. Prioritize feature development based on user request frequency and business impact. Implement new features that address the most critical user needs and gaps in the current feature set.
